jobs.name: architecture
jobs.prompt: Original production-ready cozy high-detail pixel game art, romantic cottage manor, 3/4 overhead front view, not strictly diamond isometric. Consistent tiny crisp pixel clusters, sophisticated material texture, cream plaster, warm carved wood, muted plum lavender, sage foliage, butter-gold early morning sunlight from upper left and soft shadows lower right. Matches an exquisitely detailed illustrated floral greenhouse with curved glass and climbing roses. No commercial game characters, no text or logos, no UI, no watermarks, no blur, no photographic textures. These are GAME SPRITES for actual game integration, not a concept scene. Create a TRANSPARENT sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024, precisely THREE columns and TWO rows of equally sized 512x512 cells. Each isolated object fully contained in its own cell with at least 25 pixels of transparent padding, no overlap between cells. TOP LEFT: a beautiful two-story cottage with lavender scalloped tile gable roof, chimney, cream walls and timber framing, tall warmly lit arched door centered at bottom front, flower boxes, climbing pink roses, visible right wall and eave thickness. TOP MIDDLE: gorgeous one-story florist greenhouse exterior, tall arched glass roof and lavender timber frame, double glass doors centered front, lush roses and hydrangeas hugging sides, full facade depth. TOP RIGHT: charming candy workshop cottage with dusty rose tile roof, cream wall, warm oak arched front door and glass display windows, subtle striped cream/pink awning and hanging candy decoration, no writing. BOTTOM LEFT: an elegant wooden garden bench with wrought sides and rose cushions, 3/4 view, two feet visibly grounded. BOTTOM MIDDLE: an ornate garden entry arch of cream stone and climbing pink/lavender roses, entirely isolated, open clear passage center. BOTTOM RIGHT: small round stone fountain with a carved floral pedestal, shallow luminous blue water basin and subtle actual water jets, warm mossy edges. All six complete objects independent, no floor platform, no room or shared scenery, no drawn grid, no labels, true alpha background.
